API endpoint for sending a UI-issued command to a running task instance
(e.g. "capture now", "skip this source"). Forwarded to
Task.handle_command(), which must only set a flag or push to a queue —
never perform I/O. A task that doesn't implement handle_command() (the
base implementation raises NotImplementedError) is translated into a
clean failure response here rather than an unhandled 500.

CountBboxesPayload.title: CountBboxesPayload
CountBboxesPayload.description: Same filter surface as BulkApplyAllPayload, minus the action fields.

DatasetFilterCriteria.title: DatasetFilterCriteria
DatasetFilterCriteria.description:
Stored as JSON in datasets.filter_json.

As of PR 1.4b, self-contained criteria (tags, dates, filename, whole-image
tag/label conditions) live in `terms` — the same discriminated-union shape
as ImageSearchParams.terms (see db_client.build_dataset_search_params for
how the two are combined). The remaining flat fields here are modifiers of
Dataset.label_uuids, a structurally separate column (dataset_label_links,
for FK integrity) that cannot itself live inside this JSON blob.

DatasetPreviewPayload.title: DatasetPreviewPayload
DatasetPreviewPayload.description: Request body for the unsaved-preview endpoint.

DateTerm.title: DateTerm
DateTerm.description:
Date range filter on images.created_at or images.updated_at.

`from` is a Python keyword, so the field is named `from_` internally but
aliased to "from" at the API boundary (overriding the alias_generator,
which would otherwise leave a trailing-underscore "from_" key — see
pydantic.alias_generators.to_camel). populate_by_name (inherited from
ApiModel) still accepts the Python name `from_` too.

FileEntryRead.title: FileEntryRead
FileEntryRead.description: File entry as returned by the API, optionally enriched with DB info.

FilenameTerm.title: FilenameTerm
FilenameTerm.description: AND of substring patterns against images.filename (like filename_searches).

ImageItemStatus.title: ImageItemStatus
ImageItemStatus.description: Tri-state verification status shared by per-image labels and whole-image tags.

ImageLabelState.title: ImageLabelState
ImageLabelState.description:
Discriminant state for imageLabel / imageTag filter terms.

present / absent   — the existing verified-status match.
unreviewed         — existing require_unset semantics (NOT EXISTS any row).
any_reviewed       — existing require_verified semantics (EXISTS a
                      PRESENT-or-ABSENT row).

ImageLabelTerm.title: ImageLabelTerm
ImageLabelTerm.description: Matches on the image_labels table (whole-image label assessment).

ImageLabelWithFilename.title: ImageLabelWithFilename
ImageLabelWithFilename.description: ImageLabel row joined with the image filename — used by the dataset loader.

ImageTagTerm.title: ImageTagTerm
ImageTagTerm.description: Matches on the image_tags table (whole-image tag assessment).

LabelRead.title: LabelRead
LabelRead.description: The public read-only representation of an annotation label.

LabelVerificationTerm.title: LabelVerificationTerm
LabelVerificationTerm.description:
The "Config Ready" predicate: has every target label been assessed?

label_uuids must be supplied explicitly by the caller — as of PR 1.4b
there is no flat ImageSearchParams field to fall back to. An empty list
is vacuously true/false (see _apply_filter_terms).

ObjectLabelTerm.title: ObjectLabelTerm
ObjectLabelTerm.description: Matches images having a BBOX with one of the given labels.
